_comment: Route-level paralogue windows. All paralogues in the game sit inside months 9-10 of the in-game calendar. Window detail is reported by video coverage; the per-route counts are corroborated by the wiki route locks in paralogues.json and agree exactly, which is why the counts carry cross-checked while the day-level windows stay source-reported.

windows.plan: Play to the 17th of month 9 and clear the first two. Pass time to the 24th if you want extra preparation, then make sure you are back in Dagsion on 10/18 for the last one.
windows.timeTravel: Inn Auto-Activities; one hourglass jumps to 6:00 am, when more shops and locations are open.
windows.note: Route count of 4 agrees with the wiki route locks (Vanished Carriage, Golden Secret, Orchels Regret, Friendly Match).

keyDates: 9/9 - forced start date (one of only two in the game)
9/17 - two more, must be in Dagsion
9/18 - one paralogue is available on a single day
windows.plan: Accept both quests on 9/3, pass time to 9/9 for the forced-start paralogue, finish the second before 9/15, and be in Dagsion on 9/17. Avoid map exploration during these windows so you do not roll past a deadline.
windows.timeTravel: Stop map exploration and auto-activity time progression before each critical date.
windows.note: Highest paralogue count of any route (8). Count agrees with the wiki route locks.

windows.plan: Clear the two available from 9/17, then the one that opens on 9/24 before the 5th of the next month. Be in Dagsion on 10/18 for the final three.
windows.note: The in-game text lists a later deadline than 10/24 for two of the final paralogues; 10/24 is reported as the real cut-off.

windows.plan: Do the first paralogue on or shortly after 10/5 rather than cutting it close to 10/17. Then jump to 10/18, accept all three, finish what you can, and progress to 10/23 for the forced-start one.
windows.note: Least spread-out route: all four paralogues sit inside month 10.
